purpose: Record the current-head deliverable that turns an accepted backfill tranche into a validated operator run-spec before payload fetch or conversion.

claim.statement: A single accepted tranche can be materialized into a source-agnostic operator run-spec from a TOML template, parsed as the existing RunSpec, and evaluated by the existing backfill execution-plan gate before payload work starts.
scope: accepted object count must be exactly one
accepted tranche status must be accepted
accepted tranche byte total must match the accepted object
runtime values are copied from accepted-tranche manifest, materialization spec, and TOML template
no venue, instrument, or source-specific runtime values are embedded in production code

ci.verification_policy: GitHub Actions only; no local cargo test was run for this evidence update.

red_commits.summary: Add RED test for run spec materialization
Format RED run spec materialization test

red_ci.expected_failure: bvs-test failed with unresolved import backtesting_vertical_slice::backfill_run_spec_materialization after runner disk-pressure retry was cleared

green_commits.summary: Materialize backfill run specs from accepted tranches

implementation.existing_artifact_policy: create-only/idempotent: existing identical backfill-run-spec.toml is accepted; existing different content is rejected as dirty
implementation.post_materialization_validation: The serialized TOML is parsed as operator::RunSpec before it is written as a deliverable artifact.

source_agnostic_properties: Production materialization code reads source_binding and table_family from the accepted tranche rather than matching venue names.
The focused test uses synthetic source IDs and verifies stale template source/object/table-family values are replaced.
BackfillExecutionRunBinding::from_run_spec plus evaluate_backfill_execution_plan prove the generated run-spec is Ready before payload fetch.
The sample venue guard continues to scan generic production Rust for Bybit, Binance, BNBUSDC, PMXT, Polymarket, public_archive, and related sample values.

remaining_limits.limit: This does not make arbitrary raw formats TOML-only.
remaining_limits.next_evidence_needed: A registered adapter and source proof for each new raw container, schema family, or NT data class.

remaining_limits.limit: This does not start or approve broad PMXT/Polymarket backfill.
remaining_limits.next_evidence_needed: Durable source proof, manifest/index-only coverage, bounded row-group/object budgets, and dynamic tick-size replay proof or explicit exclusion policy.

remaining_limits.limit: This does not close production artifact publication governance.
remaining_limits.next_evidence_needed: Artifact Index producer IAM or approved coordinator proof before broad production publish/delete actions.

next_safe_action: Use this materializer for accepted native-trade tranches before payload conversion, then keep broad PMXT/Polymarket and production publish/delete blocked until their separate evidence gates are complete.
